messages:
Eloise: noticed a batch of leads stuck in 'Awaiting Enrichment' last night (~50) that never progressed because the enrichment service returned a bunch of 5xxs. can we put a short-term handoff SLA in place?
Marco: thanks for flagging. proposal: if enrich hasn't returned in 25s, webhook assigns to a temporary inbound pool so leads don't sit unowned. tag contact with why.
Anya: 25s seems OK. we should also emit a metric and add a counter property so we can spot repeat offenders.
Sam: agree. SDRs hate surprises though — please add a contact note that is visible in HS and a 1-line in SDR slack when we flip this on.
Devon: also add a guard for SF sync so we don't overwrite an existing SF owner. last time it created owner churn.
Lina: plan for webhook change in staging: retry enrich once after 400ms, start 25s timer, on timeout set property 'fallback_source:webhook-25s', assign owner 'inbound-temp', increment metric 'lead.enrich.fallback.v2'.
OpsBot: synthetic event: contact.9001 enrichment_status=timeout (sim)
Marco: can we keep the fallback window configurable by header so we can widen to 60s during big batches?
Lina: yep, will add an env var FALLBACK_WINDOW_MS and a fallback_mode tag.
Anya: SF sync change: only write owner if sfdc_owner is null OR contact.force_owner=true. ignore fallback_source for owner writes.
Sam: I'll draft a 2-line SDR note: "Auto-fallback: some leads may be assigned to a temporary inbound pool if enrichment times out. Contact note shows reason; SF owner won’t change unless forced."
Devon: I'll run a 150-lead canary in staging tomorrow at 11am PT to measure fallback rate and latency.
Eloise: thanks — can we also surface fallback % on the marketing dashboard?
Anya: adding Datadog widget and a monitor: alert if fallback_rate > 1.5% for 10m.
Marco: action items: Lina deploy webhook patch to staging (Lina), Anya update SF sync (Anya), Devon run canary (Devon), Sam prep SDR blurb & monitor observability (Sam). target: ship to prod Monday if canary is green.
Lina: PR up -> https://git.redwood/infra/PR/1305. staging webhook: https://staging.hub-webhook.redwood/fallback. ping when ready to canary.
Sam: will post SDR blurb and be on deck for queue checks during canary.
Devon: canary scheduled 11:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post results here.
Marco: nice — once prod is live we'll add a short playbook: increase retries, widen fallback during batch windows, and open incident if fallback > 5% sustained for 30m.
Eloise: great work team. this should help reduce our handoff SLA misses. :rocket:
